Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp number :=0;
 NEW_ID VARCHAR(10); 
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button NUMBER; 
 sub_req varchar2(1);
begin
 if :ctrl_block_1.request_id is null then
 show_error('0080'); 
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 begin
 select submit_request into sub_req
 from hla_rbc_request
 where request_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REQUEST_ID
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 if sub_req in ('Y','E') then
 show_error('14402');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 exception 
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('15003');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO TEMP 
 FROM HLA_RBC_REQUEST
 WHERE REQUEST_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REQUEST_ID
 AND chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 
 IF TEMP > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :DONORS 
 FROM HLA_RBC_match_lists
 WHERE REQUEST_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REQUEST_ID;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :UNITS 
 FROM HLA_RBC_match_units
 WHERE REQUEST_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REQUEST_ID;
 if :ctrl_block_1.units > 0 then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_units',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 end if; 
/* Modified and verified for Y2k..... Sobha.....06/99 */
 Select to_char(max(insert_date),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
 into :ctrl_block_1.search_daytime
 from hla_rbc_match_lists
 where request_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REQUEST_ID;
 
 select initcap(sp.PAT_LAST_NAME||', '||sp.PAT_FIRST_NAME),
 sp.PAT_FIRST_NAME,initcap(h.name),
 decode(HLA_PHENO,'Y','HLA PHENO',
 decode(HLA_ANTI,'Y','HLA ANTI',
 decode(RBC_ANTI,'Y','RBC ANTI',
 decode(RBC_PHENO,'Y','RBC PHENO')))),
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE1,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY1, 
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE2,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY2,
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE3,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY3,
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE4,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY4, 
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE5,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY5,
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE6,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY6, 
 to_char(EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE7,'mm-dd-rr'), QUANTITY7, patient_id,
 hrr.unit_request,hrr.exact_match 
 into :ctrl_block_1.l_name,:ctrl_block_1.f_name,:ctrl_block_1.hospital,
 :ctrl_block_1.HLA,:EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE1,:QUANTITY1,
 :EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE2,:QUANTITY2,:EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE3,:QUANTITY3,
 :EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE4,:QUANTITY4,:EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE5,:QUANTITY5,
 :EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE6,:QUANTITY6,:EXP_TRANSFUSION_DATE7,:QUANTITY7,
 :ctrl_block_1.patient_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.cb_unit_match,:ctrl_block_1.cb_exact_match
 from special_patients sp, hla_rbc_request hrr, consignee h
 where hrr.REQUEST_ID = :ctrl_block_1.request_id and 
 hrr.patient_id = sp.pat_id and
 h.customer_id = hrr.hospital_id and
 h.consignee_id = hrr.consignee_id and
 sysdate between h.eff_date and nvl(h.term_date,sysdate+1);
 END IF; 
 patients;
 if :ctrl_block_1.HLA = 'HLA PHENO' then -- nalesh code in ('HLA PHENO','HLA ANTI') then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_filter',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_match',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_lvl',enabled,property_true);
 end if;
 
if :CTRL_BLOCK_1.status = 'CLOSE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_close','D');
else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_close',enabled,property_true);
end if;
 
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor d_rbc is select test_id,decode(result_code,'P','+','-') r
 from donor_rbc_antigens
 where donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id;
 
 dr d_rbc%rowtype;
 t_unit_id units.unit_id%type;
 t_result_code unit_test_results.result_code%type;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/04/2014. SCR 12872 
 begin
 select unit_id
 into t_unit_id
 from donations
 where donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id
 --and rownum = 1 -- Commented by Kishore on 09/16/2014. IM 10207
 and coll_date in (select max(coll_date) 
 from donations 
 where donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id) -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2014. IM 10207
 order by coll_date desc;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18024');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 select result_code
 into t_result_code
 from unit_test_results
 where unit_id = t_unit_id
 and test_id = 'CMV';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_result_code := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv := t_result_code;
 -- End of change

if :ctrl_block_1.hla = 'HLA PHENO' then
 select initcap(D.last_name),initcap(D.first_name),D.gender, 
 v.A1||' '||v.A2||' '||v.B1||' '||v.B2,description,
 'A('||NVL(da.A1,'-')||','||NVL(da.A2,'-')||') B('||NVL(da.B1,'-')||','||NVL(da.B2,'-')||')'
 into :hla_rbc_match_lists.lname,:fname,:hla_rbc_match_lists.sex,
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.pattern,:hla_rbc_match_lists.blood,
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.ANTIGENS
 from donors D,valid_hla_grading V,valid_master_codes vmc,donor_hla_antigens DA
 where 
 D.donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id and
 V.grade_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.grade_id and
 d.blood_type = vmc.code (+) and
 vmc.code_type (+) = 'ABO' and
 DA.donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id;
 --:hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv :='N'; -- Commented by Kishore on 09/04/2014. SCR 12872
elsif :ctrl_block_1.hla = 'HLA ANTI' then
 select D.last_name,D.first_name,D.gender, 
 description, -- v.A1||' '||v.A2||' '||v.B1||' '||v.B2,description,
 'A('||NVL(da.A1,'-')||','||NVL(da.A2,'-')||') B('||NVL(da.B1,'-')||','||NVL(da.B2,'-')||')'
 into :hla_rbc_match_lists.lname,:fname,:hla_rbc_match_lists.sex,
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.blood, --:hla_rbc_match_lists.pattern,:hla_rbc_match_lists.blood,
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.ANTIGENS
 from donors D,valid_hla_grading V,valid_master_codes vmc,donor_hla_antigens DA
 where 
 D.donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id and
 V.grade_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.grade_id and
 d.blood_type = vmc.code (+) and
 vmc.code_type (+) = 'ABO' and
 DA.donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id;
 --:hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv :='N'; -- Commented by Kishore on 09/04/2014. SCR 12872
else
 select D.last_name,D.first_name,D.gender,description
 into :hla_rbc_match_lists.lname,:fname,:hla_rbc_match_lists.sex,
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.blood
 from donors D, valid_master_codes vmc
 where 
 D.donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id and
 d.blood_type = vmc.code (+)and
 vmc.code_type (+) = 'ABO';
-- :hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv :='N';
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 09/04/2014. SCR 12872
 begin
 Select 'Y' into :hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv 
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :hla_rbc_match_lists.donor_id
 and inter_code = 'CMV'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and rownum < 2;
 exception
 when others then
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.cmv := 'N';
 end;
 -- End of commented section */

 FOR dr IN d_rbc
 LOOP
 :hla_rbc_match_lists.antigens := :hla_rbc_match_lists.antigens||dr.test_id ||dr.R ;
 END LOOP; 
 
end if;
